surat.headline: Embroidery labor conflicts, yarn cost spikes, and diamond export drops increase Surat MSME risks.
what_changed: Loom and weaving units are pressured by yarn price spikes of ₹50/kg and 66%, driving early closure risks ahead of Diwali despite denials from associations.
The embroidery sector faces a three-month operational deadlock, exacerbated by worker strikes, detentions, resignations, and High Court petitions over leaves and wages.
Diamond manufacturing shows divergent conditions with a 7% drop in polished diamond shipments, UK advertising scrutiny on LGDs, and localized wage default complaints.
Textile logistics and regulatory friction saw policy intervention via GST Council ITC refunds and FOSTA meetings addressing transport bottlenecks.
stress_signals: Severe margin compression and shutdown risks for weaving units due to a ₹50/kg (reported up to 66%) yarn price hike [b567711c9ed4, b62552cc0c7d].

Escalating labor unrest and a three-month impasse in embroidery, marked by over 80 worker detentions, 50 resignations, and reverse migration of textile workers to UP and Bihar [e7921383cbb7, 7697e96a190e, af8a29b318b7, d6a4b0e6a74b].
Polished diamond export shipments contracted by 7%, alongside emerging UK regulatory crackdowns on misleading LGD advertisements [975918f112f3, b1b313249339].

Direct payment defaults and trade fraud, including a ₹29.57 lakh grey fabric default, a ₹70,000 diamond processing charge default, and a ₹10.14 crore textile fraud arrest [c4997bb35d98, 698c779932f2, 2514ad7d6e20].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and reduced highway inspection checks for the textile segment [17f0a015a73c].
Central government is actively studying the Surat textile hub to formulate a national policy, with an industry scheme anticipated in three months [a3db8ea1103a, 1c99433a7c25].
Reports of a diamond sector revival raising expectations for wage cut rollbacks, alongside BOTS.Ai deployment at the Bharat Diamond Bourse [ff0f473e0921, 7eaa09c3357d].
what_to_watch: Pre-Diwali weaving operating rates and potential early unit shutdowns resulting from inability to absorb ₹50/kg yarn price increases.
Embroidery unit cash flow velocity and machinery loan/term loan servicing delays stemming from the prolonged 3-month labor impasse.
Working capital cycle impact and liquidity relief timelines from the release of GST ITC refunds.
Collection delays and receivables aging among grey-fabric suppliers and diamond job-work polishing units.
